name: Old-narrative revival
hypothesis: Buy a liquid representative after renewed independent demand exceeds its inactive baseline and price clears the revival range.
spec: Setup: A previously inactive theme may attract a fresh cohort rather than only old-holder selling. Entry: Buy a liquid representative after renewed independent demand exceeds its inactive baseline and price clears the revival range. Evaluate only information available at decision time; attempt execution afterward. Exit: Exit if dormant holders dominate selling or the range fails. Always apply the earlier of the registered maximum holding time and hard risk invalidation; fills can be delayed or unavailable. Parameters to pre-register: eligible universe and point-in-time membership, observation window and completed-event/bar rule, numerical threshold(s) named by the signal, entry order and maximum price/quote deviation, initial invalidation level and target if used, H_max and explicit session definition, cost, impact, latency, failed-attempt, and leg-risk models, position/notional/exit-capacity caps, baseline and out-of-sample rejection thresholds.
blocked_reason: needs point-in-time narrative membership and flow data beyond the six exchange-listed memecoins
